messages.subject: Executive Candidate Introduction | New Zealand Leadership Opportunities
messages.body:
Dear Aurora Careers Team,

I am reaching out regarding senior leadership and international placement opportunities in New Zealand. Your online job-placement route is currently protected by a human-verification step, so I am submitting my executive profile through your published contact channel for consideration.

I currently serve as Liaison Director at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with more than 12 years across multinational mining, regulated financial services and commercial operations. My leadership experience spans ESG and sustainability, government and regulatory relations, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, compliance coordination, strategic partnerships and cross-functional operations.

I am internationally mobile and interested in Director, Head and country-facing leadership opportunities across ESG and Sustainability, Corporate and External Affairs, Government Relations, Strategic Partnerships, Business Development and Country Operations. I would welcome consideration for suitable current or upcoming mandates where my background aligns with employer needs, including roles involving relocation or employer sponsorship.

My executive CV is attached for review. My broader profile is available at https://ragunauthramsaroop.com and https://www.linkedin.com/in/ragunauth-ramsaroop.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director | AGM Inc.
+592 608 4735
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
